rating_type: Provisional expert judgment of source suitability decisions; not measured accuracy or calibrated probability.
scope: All 100 selected rows inspected via compact source/question summaries; full source inspected for borderline structural and source-finding-only packets. Eligibility audit, manifest, chemistry decider implementation and run-embedded r2 prompts inspected.

policy.prompt_target: At least one naturally formulable source-grounded candidate plausibly >=32/40; this is an eligibility forecast, not an observed generator score.
policy.selection: weighted_eligibility_v1 balances eligible modes deterministically; final 100 selected by verifier score with language/mode quotas.

strengths: Usually selects a mode for which a clear source-only witness exists. Example row3 MX-2009001165-A process p=.85 ordered hydrotreatment/distillation/separation/recycling route.
Row12 CN-105274331-A comparison p=.82: explicit iron/copper precipitation endpoint pH 3.5 versus7.0 is naturally comparable.
Row64 CN-103772248-B process p=.87: complete mercaptopropionic-acid-to-simvastatin-sidechain-acyl-donor sequence.
Multilabel eligibility preserved: 27/100 final sources eligible for all7 modes; no zero/rare mode collapse. Selected probabilities are moderate, not near-universal 0.99 claims.

false_positive_source_level_examples.assessment: Strong concern / likely false-positive eligibility: title empty; scaffold Formula I absent; only substituent definitions and generic insecticide/acaricide/nematicide uses. Cannot identify the chemical subject for a strong standalone lookup from this packet. Assertion eligibility also .65.

false_negative_alternative_mode_examples.witness: For a diarrheal-pathogen oligonucleotide DNA chip, PCR-amplify oligonucleotides then immobilize them on a support. The source explicitly supplies both operations and object; a bounded preparation question is feasible.

For a portable rapid-test-strip reader, the camera module temporarily stores the image; analysis compares it to downloaded reference parameters and produces a report. Direct role/effect witness exists.
Interdigital acoustic-plate-wave sensor explicitly generates waves by electrostatic attraction and measures membrane oscillation capacitively; direct mechanism/role question feasible.
Reflection and transmission spectrometer embodiments both describe receiver signals; comparison of received reflected versus transmitted radiation can be formed from one continuous span.
In a split-beam optical gas/solid sensor, mirror regions direct both return beams through measurement volume to detector; component function explicitly stated.

generator_not_decider_failures: Row27 component G is poorly anchored by generator, but the full packet contains identifiable polycarbonate ingredients/effects and can support a conceptual witness.

Row42 asks a suspect full packing-stage partition (66 total vs28+17 mentioned), but the packet supports unconflicted solvent/composition/operating-condition lookups. Do not mark lookup eligibility wrong merely because generator chose the bad span.
Row95 assertion references a vague local b2 label, but source can anchor a bounded first-shell composition assertion with proper material description.
Row93 asks equality of thickness when source gives equal allowable ranges; comparison mode is still eligible for a correct range-comparison question.
recommendations: Audit rejected mode/source pairs, especially source-finding-only engineering/diagnostic packets; no recall estimate is justified from selected100 alone.
Enforce source-hidden subject identifiability for formula-only packets before accepting lookup/assertion.
Track borderline threshold decisions and repeated-screen label flips; use a fixed independent eligibility gold set for calibration.
Preserve candidate-level and rejected/failed records; report raw attempt yield separately from selected best-row quality.
Do not credit balanced final distribution to Jev, or count every bad generated question as a decider error.
limits: No precision/recall, accuracy, Brier score, calibrated probability or end-to-end raw yield can be measured from this selected set without independent labels and full attempt/failure outcomes. Counts of audit assignment skips are not generation failures. 408 screening assignments are repeat attempts, not408 unique documents.
adjudication_notes: Row63 is not counted as an eligibility failure: named functional inhibitor class supports a target lookup without reconstructing Formula I.
Source-level eligibility and the quality of the realized candidate are assessed separately.
